name: busy-claude
description: Mirror Claude Code's lifecycle state (working, waiting, limit, finished, error, ready, idle) on a BUSY Bar front display using lifecycle hooks. No model tokens consumed.

DEVICE_URL.title: Device URL
DEVICE_URL.description: BUSY Bar API base URL. USB default, or a LAN/cloud address.

AUTH_MODE.title: Authentication mode
AUTH_MODE.description: Connection type. USB needs no token; Wi-Fi uses the API password; cloud uses a BUSY account API token.

AUTH_TOKEN.title: Authentication token
AUTH_TOKEN.description: Wi-Fi API password or BUSY cloud API token. Empty for USB.

STATUS_UPDATES_ENABLED.title: Status updates
STATUS_UPDATES_ENABLED.description: Enable or disable sending lifecycle state to the BUSY Bar.

REQUEST_TIMEOUT.title: Request timeout
REQUEST_TIMEOUT.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for each BUSY Bar request (0.1-30).

STALE_SESSION_SECONDS.title: Stale session timeout
STALE_SESSION_SECONDS.description: Seconds before a session that emitted no hook event is removed (1-86400).

DEBUG_LOGGING.title: Debug logging
DEBUG_LOGGING.description: Write debug logs to debug.log under the plugin data directory.

WORKING_LABEL.title: WORKING label
WORKING_LABEL.description: Text shown on the bar while Claude is working.

WAITING_LABEL.title: WAITING label
WAITING_LABEL.description: Text shown while Claude waits for input.

LIMIT_LABEL.title: LIMIT label
LIMIT_LABEL.description: Text shown while Claude is held up by a usage or rate limit.

FINISHED_LABEL.title: FINISHED label
FINISHED_LABEL.description: Text shown when a response finishes.

ERROR_LABEL.title: ERROR label
ERROR_LABEL.description: Text shown on a failed stop.

READY_LABEL.title: READY label
READY_LABEL.description: Text shown when a session is open and waiting for its first prompt.

IDLE_LABEL.title: IDLE label
IDLE_LABEL.description: Text shown when no session is active.

SUBTITLE_COLOR.title: Subtitle color
SUBTITLE_COLOR.description: #RRGGBBAA color of the activity subtitle shown while working.

MASCOT.title: Claude mascot
MASCOT.description: Show an animated Claude mascot on the left of the display that reacts to the current state. Uploads five small animations to the bar.

WORKING_ANIMATION.title: Working animation
WORKING_ANIMATION.description: Play a progress animation along the bottom of the display while Claude is working. Uploads one small asset to the bar.
